fullContent:
Gandharvahasthadi Kashayam – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Sahasra Yoga Kashaya prakarana, 394, Vatahara Kwatha. 
 Introduction 
 Gandharvahasthadi Kashayam is an Ayurvedic medicine in the herbal decoction form. This ayurvedic medicine is used to treat the diseases which are due to the imbalance of vata doshas. It is used in digestion problem like flatulence, anorexia and bloating etc. 
 गन्धर्वहस्त चिरबिल्व हुताशविश्व । 
 पथ्या पुनर्नवा यवासक भुमितालै: ॥ 
 क्वाथस्सुसैन्धवगुड: पवनस्य शान्त्यै: । 
 वह्नेर्बलायरुचये मलशोधनाय ॥ 
 Ingredients 
 
 Gandharvahasta – castor seed – Ricinus communis 
 Chirabilva – Holoptelea integrifolia 
 Hutasha – Chitraka – Plumbago zeylanica 
 Vishwa – Ginger – Zingiber officinalis 
 Pathya – Harad – Terminalia chebula 
 Punarnava – Boerhaavia diffusa 
 Yavasa – Alhagi pseudalhagi 
 Bhumiamla – Phyllanthus niruri 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All the above mentioned ingredients are added with 8 parts of water. It is boiled until reduced to quarter part to make the Gandharvahasthadi Kwatha (Kashayam). 
 Dosage 
 
 Take 5-10 ml, on empty stomach or before food with lukewarm water once or twice a day or as directed by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Traditionally it is administered along with rock and jaggery. 
 If the kashayam is concentrated, then it needs to be mixed with equal quantity of water and should be taken. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Bloating 
 Has cleansing effect over intestines 
 Loss of appetite 
 Anorexia 
 Abdominal gas and pain 
 Constipation 
 High blood pressure 
 Low back pain 
 Sciatica 
 
 Gandharvahastadi Kashayam for Nitya Virechana 
 As it has mild purgative property, this medicine is given in a dose of 15-30 ml, to be mixed with equal quantity of water at night, to encourage purgation on the next day. This is done on daily basis. This is called Nitya Virechana. 
 It is continued for 7-15 days based on the digestion strength of the patient and strength of the disease. It is done in cases Vata imbalance disorders such as of lumbar Spondylosis, back pain, heal pain, foot pain, in cases of ascites, etc. 
 Side Effects 
 
 Take this medicine under the medical supervision. 
 It may worsen diarrhea in people already suffering from it. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
